title: Yemen’s Houthis say they hit a Saudi Aramco oil facility in Jizan with missiles (and possibly drones) overnight, sparking fires.
text:
Yemen’s Houthis say they hit a Saudi Aramco oil facility in Jizan with missiles (and possibly drones) overnight, sparking fires. "

"Videos of smoke are circulating and satellite data reportedly shows thermal hotspots at the site."

""
"Saudi Civil Defense briefly issued danger warnings for Jizan and Yanbu, then lifted them."

""
"No official Saudi/Aramco confirmation of damage, casualties, or production impact yet."
